class: One failed read of a flaky source ended the whole run, with the answer already saved from before
symptom: Secunetics (BambooHR), 29 September 16:39: the run stopped at 'Could not read a job description' and nothing opened. The same posting had been read at 14:38 and saved; read again a few minutes later it came back in 6 seconds.
site: BambooHR (any posting built by script: Dayforce, BambooHR ...)
root_cause: run_one asked resolve_job once; a script-built page that rendered empty that one time returned nothing, and nothing else was tried -- not a second read, not the copy an earlier run saved in data/_job_*.json.
why_tests_missed: resolve_job was tested for pages it can and cannot read, never for a page that fails once and then works, nor for the saved copy.
fix: apply.read_job reads the posting a second time when the first read finds nothing, then takes the copy an earlier run saved of the same posting (matched with safety.canonical_url, so tracking parameters do not matter). Only a posting never read before stops the run.
prevention: Every network read on the way into a run is retried once and falls back to the last good copy it already holds; a single empty answer from a script-built page is not a fact.
